description_en: Supports structured recognition and output of key fields, such as invoice code, invoice number, invoice date, invoice amount, value-added tax (VAT) amount, certificate number, purchaser name, and purchaser ID number or organization code
description_zh: 支持包括发票代码、开票号码、开票日期、发票金额、增值税税额、合格证号、购买方名称、购买方身份证号/代码等关键字段结构化识别输出
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-car-invoice --url https://img.alicdn.com/tfs/TB1hC7bXCzqK1RjSZPcXXbTepXa-832-616.jpg --biz-body '图片二进制文件' --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeCarInvoice

parameters.help_en:
* This field and the body field are mutually exclusive; you must specify one and only one.  
* Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes; base64 is not supported).
parameters.help_zh:

parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en:
* This field and the URL field are mutually exclusive; you must specify one and only one.  
* Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB in size.  
* When invoking via HTTP, upload the binary file in the HTTP body.  
* When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK's body.
